name: PingOne Sign-in LAB
description: How a PingOne-style pi.flow sign-in behaves: failures, lockout, replay, MFA, step-up (RFC 9470) and CIBA with a mock phone. Mock only, a simulation of behaviour. Real PingOne shapes and live use are in pingone-LAB.
notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 6171, loopback only; mock only, no settings). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:6171 only). Catalog id A11, with A5 (step-up) and A4 (CIBA stations) as real catalog rows homed here (owner). composeFile is relative to this repo's root.
